text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Friday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The UNITA movement has agreed to send its deputies to the capital Luanda next week, but is continuing to insist on discussions with the government on its programme for national unity and reconciliation.
- The United Nations special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, said after a meeting of the joint commission that UNITA had agreed to send its deputies to Luanda before February 12.
